overview: This table holds the translated lines shown during short stories in Jujutsu Kaisen Cursed Clash.
description: Localized dialogue for short/sub stories (STDM_00xxxxx_* message ids). Scripts named STDM_SS_* have their ids rewritten to this namespace, and their lines are displayed by the same story-demo rich-text path as main demos.

ID.simple: The name a modder gives a spoken line so the right short story finds it. It also connects that line to voice audio when one is set.
ID.technical: FName ID column of FGameDataTableRow_GameText; the exports also use it as the DataTable row name, which is what exact FindRow resolution uses. GameScript_GetStoryTextId detects 'STDM_SS_' in a script name, replaces that prefix with 'STDM_00' and appends '01' (STDM_SS_001 -> STDM_0000101), and AGameTextManager::FindTextIdsContaining collects every GameText row whose ID contains that key (case-insensitive, across all loaded tables); UGameScriptPlayer::UpdateLoad sorts the returned ids into FGameScriptContext::MessageIdList. GameScript_IsSubStoryScript uses the same substring test for script preload, where sub-stories hard-code the 'Part' cue sheet; FGameScriptCommand_ShowMessageBase::ParseVoice repeats the substring check directly and selects Tables->ShortStoryVoiceDataTables (from ShortStoryVoiceDataTable) for the message-id -> Voice join. ShortStoryDemoTextDataTable_<Language> is the ninth of the 14 configured GameText base names (zero-based index 8 in the initializer); null tables are skipped when the live TextDataTables array is rebuilt.

Text.simple: The translated words the player sees on screen during a short story. Change this to edit the line shown at that moment.
Text.technical: FString Text column (+0x10 in FGameDataTableRow_GameText; empty on the default row). UGameStoryDemoMultiRichTextBlockWidget::DisplayMessage calls GetGameTextById(MessageId), which builds an FGameTextRequest in the current language with empty parameters; GetGameText reads the first matching row's Text and runs AGameTextManager::FormatText (GLO from the glossary cache, DYN from request parameters, with optional modifiers) before UGameWidgetMarkupParseProcessor::Parse builds the displayed lines. A missing row or an empty Text yields an empty string. All 11 exports have 627 rows with identical ids, no empty Text and no <TYPE=KEY> markup, including no GLO/DYN tags; recognized tags would still be substituted if authored. The same message ids are used by ParseVoice, but only when TimeId is not the TEXT_TIME_NONE sentinel: ShortStoryVoice.Id -> Voice.Id_Voice supplies CueSheetName/CueName queued with the message delay and slot.

notes: FGameDataTableRow_GameText with 11 exported language variants (627 rows each; all variants share the same row ids and ID values, and none has an empty Text or <TYPE=KEY> markup). Covers the ninth of the 14 configured GameText base names in AGameTextManager::StartLanguageLoading/Tick (zero-based index 8); only successfully loaded non-null tables are appended. Config/DefaultGame.ini:35-45 assigns each language suffix its own cook chunk.

ShortStoryDataTable (45 rows) carries Id_Script = STDM_SS_*, Id_ShortStoryCharacter and Id_StoryText_Title; all 45 script values rewrite to the 45 seven-digit prefixes present in this table (STDM_SS_001 -> STDM_0000101). The title id (e.g. STR_STDM_SS_001) is a StoryTextDataTable entry in all 11 language exports, not a row here; the list widget sets that id directly on its button text (GameStoryCharaRelateShortStoryListItemWidget.cpp:100).

FindTextIdsContaining scans Row->ID with case-insensitive FString::Contains across every row of every non-null table in TextDataTables, not a table-specific query; UpdateLoad sorts the returned ids. Exact lookup uses DataTable row names and FindTextRow returns the first table containing the key (TextDataTables order: Glossary, Battle, Item, CommandList, Chat, Stamp, StoryText, StoryDemo, ShortStoryDemo, Tutorial, BattleSubTitle, Sound, Dlc1, Dlc2). A duplicate id in an earlier table would therefore supply Text while discovery could also return the id more than once; no exported En row key in the other GameText groups overlaps these 627 ids.

Voice is joined outside this table: ParseVoice skips TimeId=TEXT_TIME_NONE, matches the displayed MessageId against ShortStoryVoiceDataTable rows and then VoiceDataTable by Id_Voice; 580 of the 627 exported ids have a ShortStoryVoice row, and all 244 referenced Voice ids exist in VoiceDataTable. UGameScriptPlayer::UpdateLoad instead hard-codes cue sheet 'Part' for sub-story preload and does not read that join.

Reconstruction caveat: status/functions.json marks FindTextIdsContaining (0x14b0100) byte-matched (`match`; lane verdict HOLD over an unresolved call identity), FindTextRow (0x14af290) and Tick (0x14c96f0) BEHAV-certified (NA15/BG03), and GetGameTextById (0x14af690), GetGameText (0x14af510) and FormatText (0x14c4870) byte-matched. GameScript_GetStoryTextId (0x1436630) and UpdateLoad (0x1440570) are BEHAV-certified. Content is partial; no exhaustive retail or Blueprint-only usage claim.

usages.detail: Creates the primary-asset loader for ShortStoryDemoTextDataTable_<Language>.
Appends the resolved ShortStoryDemoTextDataTable_<Language> to the combined TextDataTables cache in Tick.
GameScript_GetStoryTextId rewrites STDM_SS_<n> script ids to the STDM_00...01 search prefix (the STDM_SS_ test is at line 29).
Calls FindTextIdsContaining with the rewritten prefix; UpdateLoad sorts the returned ids into MessageIdList at line 240.
FindTextIdsContaining scans the ID field of every GameText row in the combined tables (matching test at line 652).
GetGameText resolves the message id to row Text and formats it at line 683 for display.
ParseVoice detects STDM_SS_ sub-stories and selects Tables->ShortStoryVoiceDataTables at line 1040 for the message-id join.
Show-message updates pass Message.MessageId to UGameStoryDemoWidget::ShowMessage.
Resolves each displayed message id to localized Text through GetGameTextById and parses it into rich-text lines.
Caches ShortStoryVoiceDataTable in DTM.ShortStoryVoiceDataTables for the indirect voice join.
Sub-story preload takes the hard-coded 'Part' cue sheet branch instead of using the voice-table join.
